description: RFC 8785 JCS canonicalization fixture: input object -> canonical string -> UTF-8 bytes -> SHA-256. A conforming canonicalizer MUST produce byte-identical output.

expected.note: Keys sorted by UTF-16 code unit, no whitespace, strings NFC-normalised (a: e+combining-acute -> U+00E9). Any deviation changes the SHA-256 and would break signature verification.
